question: Why is śakti declared to have primacy among all the gods?
premises: Without śakti, all is described as inert and senseless.
A conclusion is drawn from that inertness.
Primacy is attributed to śakti among all gods.
inference: Because all is inert without śakti, śakti is declared supreme among all gods.
plain_english: Therefore, among all the gods, the primacy of śakti is declared.
